body:
sara: Heads-up — docs PR #7834 needs snippet updates for streaming + pagination + retry interplay. Current examples can emit duplicate pages when a retry restarts the stream. Reproduced in Py/TS/Go. Steps and proposed fixes below.

ben: Ugh, saw that in e2e. The TS example uses a naive cursor reset on retry. We should show idempotent resume using next_cursor + seen set.

maria: I can update the SDK examples, but need the canonical suggested snippets for each language to keep parity. Can you paste the problematic code?

sara: Problematic Python snippet (from docs):
```py
# BAD: may re-yield pages if retry triggers mid-stream
for page in client.list_items_stream(page_size=100):
    for item in page.items:
        yield item
```
Proposed change: show how to use page tokens + last-seen offset and include retry-safe guard: maintain last_cursor and skip pages with cursor <= last_cursor.

tom: For TS we should prefer the async iterator pattern but add a small helper that dedups by id on the fly. Example idea: `seenIds = new Set(); for await (const page of client.streamList()) { page.items.filter(i => !seenIds.has(i.id)).forEach(i => { seenIds.add(i.id); ... }) }`

lee: Go edge: callbacks make it tempting to re-enqueue the same callback on retry. Suggest doc shows a wrapper: `wrapDedup(cb)`, keep a map of seen keys per stream. Keep examples short.

maria: I'll draft Py/TS/Go snippets mirroring the same pattern: keep resume token + small dedupe set. Also include a note about memory: advise TTL-based cleanup for long-lived streams.

sara: Also callout: when combining retries + pagination, explain the semantics of server-provided cursors vs client-side offsets. Add a short section: "Prefer server cursor; fall back to idempotent client guards."

ben: PR coordination: sara can you add a checklist comment in #7834: update three language files under docs/snippets/, add unit test snippet for pagination retry scenario, and ask SDK owners for sign-off?

sara: Yep — added checklist to the PR. @maria can you assign to @ben and @tom for review when ready?

ci-bot: CI: snippet-lint passed for changed files, but example-tests failed in py-stream-retry scenario (flaky). See https://ci.redwood.internal/12034

maria: I'll push a WIP branch in ~30m with the three language patches. Will add an inline note about memory vs correctness tradeoff and link to optimize batching docs.

ben: Thx — if anyone runs into the flaky test, try local repro with `RUST_LOG=debug` on the runtime to see retry frames.

sara: Great. Once WIP is up I'll do docs copyedit and merge once SDK owners ok. :thumbsup:

tom: One more: add a short compatibility note for older SDK clients that don't surface cursor metadata — give a fallback snippet that uses stable ids + idempotent handlers.

lee: ACK. I'll add a QA checklist item to ensure samples run against both hosted and dedicated infra.

maria: Uploaded branch `docs/stream-pagination-dedupe` and linked in #7834. Put a TODO to convert the TS helper to an exported util in devex later.

ben: Reviewing now. Leaving inline comments about variable names and adding a small test showing retry mid-page.

sara: Awesome. Closing the thread once merged.
